Image 3 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep its entire upper body, head, costume, fox, snowflake, framing and scale unchanged. Only redraw the legs and the very bottom hem for the specified genuine walk pose. No copy, mirror, warp, interpolation, or translated pose.
Keep the same lower-right-facing camera and two boot tracks. This is one phase BEFORE reference 3: the character RIGHT boot on SCREEN-LEFT is BEHIND and supports weight on its toe, heel slightly raised. Its toe visibly reaches the ground baseline. The character LEFT boot on SCREEN-RIGHT is FORWARD and extends toward bottom-right, with its heel hovering above ground and toe slightly up, not planted yet. Keep the screen-right forward boot higher off the ground than reference 3 by a small amount. No boot may cross to the other track. Compact natural step, no kicking.
Two anatomically connected legs only. Keep same short chibi proportions, camera and facing. Full body isolated on transparent RGBA canvas, native at least 1024 square. Highest finish. No added tail, no floor, shadow, grid or text. Both original boots point in same direction as her nose. At least one foot supports body weight. Preserve all original identity and accessories.
